messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: metrics-pipeline.prometheus_scrape_failures firing for job=prometheus-scrape (severity=page)

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Triggered incident #PD-4421 - prom_scrape_failures (pager duty routing: eng-sre)

maya (oncall): acked via PagerDuty. I'm on it. @raj can you help look at monitoring cluster? :eyes:

raj (eng-sre): I'm diving in. Quick check: are we seeing scrape 503s or timeout? I saw a spike in scrape latency earlier.

maya (oncall): Dashboard shows scrape_success_rate dropped to ~60% across targets, and `metrics-store` ingestion lag increasing. Kibana shows `log_ingest_consumer_group` lag > 200k.

raj (eng-sre): Running quick tail of Prometheus logs:

```
kubectl -n monitoring logs prometheus-0 | tail -n 200
2026-03-13T02:14:01Z ts=... caller=scrape.go:905 level=warn component="scrape" target="node-exporter/10.2.5.7:9100" msg="error scraping target" err="Get \"http://10.2.5.7:9100/metrics\": read tcp 10.2.3.5:42122->10.2.5.7:9100: i/o timeout"
2026-03-13T02:14:02Z ts=... caller=scrape.go:905 level=warn component="scrape" target="coredns/10.3.2.2:9153" msg="error scraping target" err="received HTTP status 503"
```

raj (eng-sre): So mixed timeouts and 503s. Looks like a network flakiness to node-exporter and some service-side rate limiting.

maya (oncall): Also seeing log-ingest consumer group lag in Kafka topic `logs-ingest-raw`:

```
kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.cluster:9092 --describe --group log-ingest-consumer
TOPIC	PARTITION	CURRENT-OFFSET	LOG-END-OFFSET	LAG
logs-ingest-raw	0	1234000	1456000	222000
... (all partitions similar)
```

jules (eng-infra): Paging in from infra: our eBPF-based node-exporter sidecars had a recent config roll that bumped scrape concurrency. Rolling back that change might reduce pressure. I'm looking at DaemonSet rollout history.

sam (eng-platform): I see increased CPU on kafka-connect and enrolls in pod logs: consumers are falling behind because of GC spikes on the ingest workers. Possibly S3 write throughput is degraded and backpressure is accumulating.

maya (oncall): Impact: Redwood Console metrics are partially stale for some clusters, internal alerts based on those metrics are delayed. No API 5xxs reported. Customers may see missing graphs and late anomaly emails.

raj (eng-sre): Mitigation plan:
1) throttle Prometheus scrape concurrency by patching ConfigMap to lower `scrape_concurrency` and `scrape_timeout` where we've changed defaults.
2) restart node-exporter on a few noisy nodes to recover 503s.
3) scale up log-ingest consumers by +3 replicas and temporarily increase Kafka consumer parallelism.
4) open S3/Kafka tickets with cloud infra if throughput doesn't improve.

maya (oncall): I'll execute 1 and 2 now. @sam can you scale the consumer set? I'll coordinate the handoff if we need to escalate.

sam (eng-platform): On it. Scaling log-ingest to +3.

```
kubectl -n logging scale deployment/log-ingest-consumers --replicas=10
kubectl -n monitoring patch configmap/prometheus-scrape-cfg -p '{"data":{"scrape_concurrency":"10","scrape_timeout":"10s"}}'
```

opsbot: Deploy started: rollout/logging/log-ingest-consumers -> replicas: 7 -> 10

jules (eng-infra): Rolling back node-exporter config to previous commit to avoid the concurrency change. Applying now.

maya (oncall): After changes: scrape_success_rate climbed from 61% -> 85% over the last 2 mins. Kafka lag dropped ~30k after consumer scale. Still above baseline but trending down.

raj (eng-sre): Good. Keep monitoring for 15 mins. If scrape errors drop below 5% and lag continues to decrease we can close the page. Also add temporary suppressions on downstream alerts so we don't cascade.

maya (oncall): Added silence to alert `metrics-pipeline.prometheus_scrape_failures` for 30m and muted some noisy dashboard alerts.

pagerduty: Incident PD-4421 acknowledged by maya (oncall).

sam (eng-platform): Consumer pods show lowered GC times after scaling. S3 put metrics show an increase in 90th percentile latency but still within retry budget.

maya (oncall): Customer impact note for incident timeline (working draft):
- 02:14 UTC: Prometheus scrape failures spike; automated page triggered.
- 02:16 UTC: On-call ack (maya). Initial triage shows mix of 503s/timeouts and log-ingest consumer lag.
- 02:20 UTC: Mitigations applied — reduce scrape concurrency, restart node-exporters, scale log-ingest consumers.
- 02:28 UTC: Metrics success rate improved to 85%, Kafka lag decreasing.
- 02:40 UTC: Monitoring shows continued recovery; no API errors observed. Suggest post-mortem and customer communication if any users reported missing graphs.

raj (eng-sre): Agreed. I'll take the RCA owner if that's ok. Need logs from the node-exporter rollout and the config change diff.

jules (eng-infra): I've attached the rollback diff in the infra ticket. Link: https://internal.redwood/infra/rollbacks/873

maya (oncall): Handing off to raj for ongoing RCA tracking. I'll stay available for another 20m then switch to next on-call (sylvia).

maya (oncall): sylvia (next-oncall) @sylvia please be ready to take the page in ~20m. Current status: stabilizing, mitigation applied, monitoring.

opsbot: Next on-call scheduled: sylvia at 03:05 UTC.

sam (eng-platform): I'll open a follow-up task to add better backpressure propagation and a dashboard for consumer lag thresholds. action: PLAT-1245.

raj (eng-sre): Notes for RCA: investigate the eBPF sidecar config change, evaluate whether scrape concurrency defaults were safe for noisy clusters, and add runbook steps for scaling consumers and silencing alerts.

maya (oncall): Closing the immediate page: incident-bot cleared for PD-4421 pending RCA. If we see reoccurrence within 30m I'll reopen.

incident-bot: ALERT: metrics-pipeline.prometheus_scrape_failures resolved (alert cleared)

maya (oncall): Thanks everyone. I'll draft the incident summary and CC product/support for any customer comms. :thumbsup:
